build.title: Compact screens pass 2: orchestrator filters, Home actions, catalog, tracker, asset studio — button walls into dropdowns and ⋯ menus

said.text: 'More compact screens' after app-compact (PR #178). Per-screen: replace rows/walls of buttons and filter chips with one dropdown or a ⋯ menu, shorten page descriptions, tighten lists. Profile: Angel. Web only.

steps.text: Before screenshots: Home, Build orchestrator, Catalog, Tracker, Asset studio, Build queue (phone + desktop)
Build orchestrator: tabs + Grid/List + category chips + Next on Fable/Opus become one compact toolbar (category dropdown, view toggle, next-model dropdown)
Home: page actions row (Open project, Terminal, Export plan, Token, Tracker) → 2 main buttons + ⋯ menu; summary cards denser
Catalog + Tracker: filter chip rows → one dropdown each; item rows one line with status chip; Asset studio slot chips → dropdown
Checks, after screenshots, report + LOG, PR
